# About me
I earned my B.S in Biology and Master's degree in Bioengineering from the **University of Puerto Rico at Mayaguez (UPRM)** where I am currently pursuing a Ph.D. in Bioengineering. My research focuses on the use of Digital Twin technology to develop computational simulations of the immune system. Specifically, I am interested in understanding how perturbations in immune responses following viral infection may contribute to the development of autoimmune conditions.
